faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About
faqs.subheading: Clear answers covering the independence of our two flagship platforms, offline desktop setup, 5-in-1 restaurant modules, and custom agency projects.

items.question: Are the Restaurant Management System and Fast POS connected or separate products?
items.answer: They are two completely separate, standalone products designed for different businesses. Our Full-Fledged Restaurant Management System is a connected 5-in-1 restaurant ecosystem (Website, In-Store POS, Call Center, Inventory, and Riders). Fast POS is a 100% offline single-PC desktop Point of Sale with zero cloud or hosting dependency.

items.question: How does the Full-Fledged Restaurant Management System unify all 5 modules?
items.answer: All customer orders — whether placed on your branded Customer Ordering Website, punched at your In-Store Restaurant POS (dine-in or takeaway), or booked by staff in the Call Center Order Portal — flow into one unified central queue. From that single hub, Integrated Inventory automatically deducts recipe ingredients and the Delivery Rider System assigns riders and settles cash.

items.question: Does Fast POS require internet or any monthly cloud/hosting fees?
items.answer: No! Fast POS runs 100% offline on a single Windows counter PC. Because there are no cloud servers or external databases involved, your billing, barcode scanning, receipt printing, and local reports never stop if Wi-Fi drops, and you pay zero recurring monthly cloud or hosting fees.

items.question: What daily store operations are included in Fast POS?
items.answer: Fast POS handles every single-counter retail task inside one local desktop application: fast barcode billing, 58mm/80mm thermal slip printing, local stock inventory and low-stock alerts, customer credit/khata ledgers, daily shop expense tracking, and daily profit and sales Z-reports.

items.question: What hardware works with these systems, and can we visit your Lahore office?
items.answer: Both systems work with standard 58mm/80mm thermal receipt printers, 1D/2D barcode scanners, automatic cash drawers, weighing scales, and Windows counter PCs or touch screens. Visit our Model Town Link Road, Lahore office Monday to Saturday (9 AM – 6 PM) or call/WhatsApp 0315-4112925 for a live hardware demonstration.

items.question: Can EBRICKS SOLUTIONS build custom websites, mobile apps, or manage digital ads too?
items.answer: Yes. Beyond our two standalone flagship products, EBRICKS SOLUTIONS is a full-service software and digital growth agency delivering custom static/dynamic websites, custom SaaS web portals, iOS/Android Flutter apps, Shopify & WooCommerce stores, bespoke desktop software, SEO, Google Ads, and Meta/TikTok social media marketing.
